title: CertificationStatusChangedPayload
description: Payload of the CertificationStatusChanged event, published by tenancy-svc when the stored certification of a tenant turns STALE or CURRENT, and consumed by submission-svc, which carries the stale status into the readiness output as DEP-006 (INV-REQ-1135, INV-AC-16047; ruling INV-Q-16401 option A). One event per transition, never per repeat. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The entity whose certification changed status.

status.description: The certification status after the transition.

trigger.description: The re-certification trigger that marked the certification stale. Present when status is STALE, absent when status is CURRENT.
